# Bulkhead (fpsrizz)

> A plugin-driven TypeScript engine for rapidly prototyping browser games. A generic kernel (host, registries, entity
> store, buses, scheduler, scopes) runs plugins that declare manifests; games are composed from presets that pick
> plugins and exclusive roles. Rendering uses Three.js 0.187 behind a capability-gated render SDK. Node >= 22.18,
> esbuild, node:test, Playwright.

Rules agents must follow: reuse existing mechanics before writing new ones (`npm run find-reuse -- "<need>"`); never
move gameplay into `packages/kernel/src`; game plugins import only their own folder, `packages/sdk/src/index.ts`, `packages/sdk/src/render.ts`
and their family's contracts; run `npm run check` after every change and never weaken a test or lint rule.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): layout, import boundaries, conventions, checks, rules
- [Docs map](docs/README.md): guide, reference, cookbook, games, archive

- [Reuse](docs/guide/reuse.md): capability search and composition before new code

- [Architecture](docs/reference/architecture.md): layers, ownership, tick order, rendering decisions
